gaps.sentence: She explained the process ___ (PATIENT) to each visitor.
The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
Their ___ (FRIEND) goes back to their university days.
gaps.explanation: 'Friendship' is the relationship between friends; 'friendliness' is a manner.
'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.

gaps.sentence: The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.
